en.g: Talk about actions between two or more people.
p: Each other = one to the other and back: Ana and Leo help each other. (Ana helps Leo, Leo helps Ana.)
Compare: They looked at themselves (in the mirror) vs They looked at each other.
Together = in the same place or activity: We cook together on Sundays.
en.q: Who do you help, and how do you and that person support each other?

Together = zusammen, am selben Ort oder bei derselben Tätigkeit: We cook together on Sundays.
